About / Vivek Ghode
Product designer · Rider · Builder

More than screens.

I’m a Product Designer who likes understanding how things work, making them easier to use, and learning by building.

Designing with curiosity and intent.

I work across product strategy, UX and visual design—from early ambiguity to shipped experiences. I’m most at home simplifying complex workflows, shaping 0→1 products, and building systems that help teams move with clarity.

My practice is grounded in understanding the people using a product, the context around their decisions, and the business reality behind the work. I care about useful outcomes more than decorative complexity.

Focus0→1 · B2B SaaS · Mobile
ApproachSystems thinking · Craft · Collaboration
Based inPune, India
